parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The URL or IP address of the monitoring task.

parameters.name: AlertIds
parameters.description: The ID of the alert rule. The ID of an existing alert rule in CloudMonitor. You can call the DescribeMetricRuleList operation to query alert rule IDs. For more information, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).

parameters.name: CustomSchedule
parameters.description: The custom monitoring schedule. You can select a specific time period from Monday to Sunday for monitoring.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The monitoring frequency. Valid values: 1, 5, and 15. Unit: minutes. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: IntervalUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the monitoring metrics.

Unit: milliseconds (ms).

parameters.name: IspCities
parameters.description:
The detection point information. The value is in JSONArray format, for example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`, where `city` corresponds to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao respectively.

> You can call the DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList operation to query detection point information. For more information, see [DescribeSiteMonitorISPCityList](~~115045~~). If this parameter is left empty, the system randomly selects three detection points.

parameters.name: OptionsJson
parameters.description: The advanced extended options for the protocol type of the monitoring task. Different protocol types correspond to different extended options.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the monitoring task.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The name of the monitoring task. The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters.
